description_en: Bindss authorization to machines in Security Center
name: BindAuthToMachine

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The authorization version of the asset. Valid values:

6: Anti-virus Edition
5: Advanced Edition
3: Enterprise Edition
7: Ultimate Edition
10: Value-added Service Edition
fields.help_zh:
资产的授权版本。取值：

6：防病毒版
5：高级版
3：企业版
7：旗舰版
10：增值服务版
fields.name: auth_version

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic binding. Valid values:

0: disabled
1: enabled
fields.help_zh:
开启自动绑定。取值：

0：关闭
1：开启
fields.name: auto_bind

fields.help_en:
The collection of UUIDs to bind.

Bind and UnBind cannot both be empty.
Maximum number of child entries: 1000
fields.help_zh:
绑定的 UUID 集合。

Bind 和 UnBind 不能同时为空。
子级条数 <= 1000
fields.name: bind

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to bind all assets. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
fields.help_zh:
是否全量绑定。默认false，取值：

true：是
false：否
fields.name: bind_all

fields.help_en:
The search conditions for assets. This parameter is in JSON format. Pay attention to the letter case when you specify this parameter.
You can search for assets by instance ID, instance name, VPC ID, region, public IP address, and other conditions. You can call the DescribeCriteria operation to query the supported search conditions
fields.help_zh:
设置搜索资产的条件。该参数 JSON 格式，输入参数时注意大小写。
支持使用资产的实例 ID、实例名称、所属 VPC ID、地域、公网 IP 地址等条件搜索资产。您可以调用 DescribeCriteria 接口查询支持的搜索条件
fields.name: criteria

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether this is a pre-binding operation. Valid values:

0: no
1: yes

After pre-binding is enabled, the corresponding authorization quota is automatically bound to the specified servers after the purchase is completed
fields.help_zh:
是否预绑定操作。取值：

0：否
1：是


开启预绑定后，会在完成购买后自动为指定服务器绑定对应版本的授权数
fields.name: is_pre_bind

fields.help_en:
The logical relationship between multiple search conditions. Valid values:

OR: The search conditions are in an OR relationship.
AND: The search conditions are in an AND relationship
fields.help_zh:
设置多个搜索条件间生效的逻辑关系。取值：

OR：表示多个搜索条件之间是或的关系。
AND：表示多个搜索条件之间是与的关系
fields.name: logical_exp

fields.help_en:
The order version associated with the pre-binding. Valid values:

level7: Anti-virus Edition
level3: Advanced Edition
level2: Enterprise Edition
level8: Ultimate Edition
level10: value-added service only
fields.help_zh:
预绑定关联的订单版本。取值：

level7：防病毒版
level3：高级版
level2：企业版
level8：旗舰版
level10：仅采购增值服务
fields.name: ntm_version

fields.help_en:
The order ID associated with the pre-binding.
Note: This field is of the Long type. Precision loss may occur during the sequence/deserialization procedure. The value must not exceed 9007199254740991
fields.help_zh:
预绑定关联的订单编号。
注意 该字段类型为 Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于 9007199254740991
fields.name: pre_bind_order_id

fields.help_en:
The collection of UUIDs to unbind.
Bind and UnBind cannot both be empty
fields.help_zh:
解绑的UUID集合。
Bind和UnBind不能同时为空
fields.name: un_bind

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see error codes
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见错误码

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful. For more information, see the following parameters
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据。详情请参见以下参数

BindCount.description_en: The number of servers that are successfully bound

InsufficientCoreCount.description_en: The number of insufficient core-based authorization quotas
InsufficientCoreCount.description_zh: 授权核数授权数不足的数量

InsufficientEcsCount.description_en: The number of insufficient server-based authorization quotas
InsufficientEcsCount.description_zh: 授权服务器授权数不足的数量

RequestId.description_en: The request ID of Security Center

ResultCode.description_en:
The status code of the binding result. Valid values:

0: success.
1: parameter error.
2: insufficient server authorization quota.
3: insufficient server core authorization quota
ResultCode.description_zh:
绑定结果状态码。取值：

0：成功
1：参数错误
2：缺少服务器授权数
3：缺少服务器授权核数

UnBindCount.description_en: The number of servers that are successfully unbound

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的 ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. true: The call is successful. false: The call fails
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true：调用成功。                                 false：调用失败
